Authentic Vietnamese food just a few steps away from Main Street
Jul 2025 • Family
We have been on a tour with Lana and afterwards she took us with her to her own restaurant, where her husband is the chef. We really had a very good experience and had the best food of our Vietnamtrip. The superfresh food kept coming and Lana told us the papaya in the papayasalad came from the garden of her mother en she told us she had been to the market earlier the morning to buy fresh meat and fish. 
Our young children liked to play with Lana’s children, so it was really nice! 
In busy and touristic Tam Coc it is hard to find an authentic place to eat, but this is a true hidden gem, just a few steps away from the Main Street. 
Highly recommended!

Highly recommend both the restaurant and her guiding services!
Feb 2025 • Couples
Lana's restaurant is in a great location, offering excellent food that is both delicious and flavorful. The service was warm and welcoming, making it a true hidden gem in Tam Coc.

Lana was also our guide for two days, and her connections made a huge difference—helping us skip queues and ensuring we experienced the top attractions seamlessly. Everything was well-organized, and she was a delightful host, passionate about sharing the history and background of the places we visited.

Highly recommend both the restaurant and her guiding services!
